title: FAC-FD-001 is absent from claimed canonical Business definition surfaces
description: FAC-FD-001 approves five distinct concepts and defines Business as an Organization-domain operating identity. The PIA controlled vocabulary defines Tenant, Facility, Organization, Barn, Facility Area, Association, and Active Context but omits Business; the machine-readable definitions object likewise has no Business key; and the data dictionary references Business operation without defining its meaning or responsibility. This contradicts the incorporation register's claim that FAC-FD-001 was incorporated into PIA, DATA_DICTIONARY, and MACHINE_READABLE and fails the mandated distinct-concepts check.
required_action: Define Business and its responsibility distinctly in the PIA controlled vocabulary, data dictionary, and machine-readable definition surface without inventing a separate entity or collapsing it into Organization; update traceability and refreeze the successor candidate.
verification: Fresh review confirms the approved FAC-FD-001 meaning is present and consistent across every claimed definition surface, with no collapse among Facility, Tenant, Organization, Barn, and Business.

title: Six risk rows retain obsolete open-Founder gates for approved decisions
description: FAC-RISK-001, FAC-RISK-002, FAC-RISK-003, FAC-RISK-006, FAC-RISK-007, and FAC-RISK-009 use OPEN_FOUNDER_GATE or OPEN_FOUNDER_AND_IMPLEMENTATION_GATE even though their controlling FAC-FD-001, 002, 008, 012, 015, and 016 decisions are Founder-approved design doctrine. Remaining implementation or verification exposure may stay open, but the Founder-design gate cannot. The directive says any contradiction involving an approved Founder decision is blocking.
required_action: Reclassify each affected risk to accurately distinguish approved design control from any remaining implementation, evidence, or enrollment gate; preserve the risk itself where still applicable; update consistency validation and refreeze.
verification: Fresh review finds no OPEN_FOUNDER status for a risk whose Founder-design dependencies are all FAC-FD-001 through FAC-FD-018, and each remaining open gate agrees with the 28-row gate register.

title: Frozen revised-candidate manifests omit one in-scope evidence file
description: The checksum command passes all 66 listed entries, but completeness fails. The package contains 69 files; excluding only the two present pre-review frozen-manifest files leaves 67 frozen-scope files. Both FROZEN_REVISED_CANDIDATE_MANIFEST.txt and FROZEN_REVISED_CANDIDATE_SHA256SUMS.txt omit predecessor_evidence/v1.0.0/PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json even though DOCUMENTARY_CHANGE_MANIFEST.csv classifies it as relocated-preserved evidence. The freeze script excludes every basename PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json rather than only the current manifest self-entry.
required_action: Correct the freeze selection so the relocated predecessor manifest is covered, or define a precise justified exact-path exclusion with an equivalent immutable anchor; regenerate package, frozen manifest, checksums, counts, and freeze evidence in a new candidate.
verification: Fresh completeness check reports zero unlisted files after applying only explicit review-envelope and true self-manifest exclusions, and every listed checksum passes.

title: Full traceability is not resolvable after predecessor relocation
description: Six EVIDENCE_MANIFEST locators point to paths that do not exist from the package root: the first-draft hash manifest, findings register, challenge directory, revision traceability register, second-pass summary, and validation JSON. Their files were relocated under predecessor_evidence/v1.0.0. In addition, FOUNDER_DECISION_INCORPORATION_REGISTER.csv uses unmapped artifact aliases and interface wildcards such as PIA, MACHINE_READABLE, ALL_CONTEXT_BOUND_INTERFACES, and ALL_CONSEQUENTIAL_COMMANDS. Nonempty fields are not full machine-resolvable traceability, contrary FAC-REQ-036 and the validation report's PASS claim.
required_action: Update all relocated evidence locators to concrete existing paths and replace or formally map artifact aliases and interface wildcards to exact files and stable IDs. Extend validation to resolve every path, fragment, alias, and referenced identifier before reporting PASS; then refreeze.
verification: Fresh resolver check opens every evidence locator and resolves every affected-artifact, requirement, workflow, interface, and risk/control reference to a concrete frozen artifact and stable identifier with zero gaps.

title: Core PIA retains stale predecessor identity and counts
description: The main PIA title says V1.0.0 and its document-control paragraph says candidate version 1.0.0 despite the V1.1.0 package. It also reports 13 workflows, 15 entities, and 8 API plus 3 event plus 3 job contracts, while the frozen registers contain 15 workflows, 16 entities, and 10 API plus 4 event plus 3 job contracts. It says SOURCE_REGISTER records 33 sources while the current source register and machine-readable count are 34. These stale values contradict the package's own machine-readable facts and were missed by the PASS consistency report.
required_action: Update the title, candidate version, source count, workflow count, entity count, and API/event/job counts; add exact cross-artifact count and identity assertions to documentary validation; regenerate affected hashes and manifests.
verification: Fresh review confirms the human-readable PIA identity and all counts match the frozen registers and machine-readable document exactly.
